prompt: Rendered in the style of oil painting, the scene captures a bustling airport gate where eighteen distinct entities coexist in a moment of transit. On the far left, a man in a red scarf stands firmly, his posture rigid as he clutches a black leather briefcase tightly against his side. Next to him sits an elderly woman with silver hair, her hands resting gently on a floral handbag placed upon her lap. A young boy in a blue cap leans forward from his seat, pointing excitedly at a large window that dominates the background wall. Beside the boy, a mother in a green coat looks down at a smartphone held in her right hand, ignoring the chaos around her. In the center of the composition, a pilot in a crisp uniform walks briskly, pulling a wheeled suitcase behind him with one hand while checking a wristwatch on the other. A brown dog on a leash trots faithfully next to the pilot, its tongue lolling out in anticipation. To the right of the pilot, a teenager with headphones around their neck sits slumped in a plastic chair, eyes closed in deep rest. Standing near the teenager is a businessman in a gray suit, tapping impatiently on a tablet screen. Behind them, a flight attendant in a navy dress smiles warmly, handing a boarding pass to a confused tourist wearing a wide-brimmed hat. The tourist reaches out with both hands to accept the paper, their expression one of relief. Near the check-in counter, a child in a yellow raincoat hugs a stuffed bear tightly, seeking comfort amidst the noise. A vending machine glows softly in the corner, stocked with colorful drinks that catch the ambient light. A potted palm tree stands tall near the entrance, its fronds drooping slightly under the weight of dust. A janitor pushes a cleaning cart slowly across the floor, maneuvering around a discarded coffee cup lying on the tiles. A couple shares a quiet embrace near the railing, the man in a denim jacket holding the woman in a white dress close. A stray cat peeks out from behind a luggage pile, its eyes wide and alert. A digital clock hangs high on the wall, displaying bright red numbers that seem to freeze time. There is no snow visible through the windows, suggesting a warm climate outside. There is no food being consumed by any of the travelers, keeping the area tidy. There is no advertisement poster on the walls, leaving the space stark and functional. The interplay of light and shadow defines the forms, giving weight to the fleeting moment.
